+title: Write an executor prompt cache entry to one file and read it back
+---
+#prompt-cache
+
+## What
+
+The disk tier stores one `ExecutorPromptCacheEntry` (`Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ExecutorPromptCache.swift:33`) in one safetensors file. The entry ALREADY carries `state: LMOutput.State?` (`:58`), thus the file carries caches, model state, and the two token ledgers.
+
+Create `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ExecutorPromptCacheFile.swift` with `enum ExecutorPromptCacheFile`:
+
+- `static func write(_ entry: ExecutorPromptCacheEntry, key: ExecutorPromptCacheKey, to url: URL) throws` — call `savePromptCache(url:cache:metadata:state:)` (`Libraries/MLXLMCommon/KVCache.swift:1957`). Write to `url` + `.partial` first, then rename to `url`, thus a crash never leaves a half file under the real name.
+- User metadata: `format` = `"executor-prompt-cache-1"`, `modelID`, `sessionID`, `tokens` and `renderTokens` (each as base64 of little-endian Int32 values; say in a comment that a token id never exceeds Int32), `byteCount`.
+- `static func read(from url: URL, key: ExecutorPromptCacheKey, templates: [KVCache]) throws -> ExecutorPromptCacheEntry` — call `loadPromptCacheSnapshot(url:into:)` from task ^jvag56k. Throw when `format`, `modelID` or `sessionID` differ from `key`, or when a ledger does not decode.
+- `static func fileName(for key: ExecutorPromptCacheKey) -> String` — a stable, file-system-safe name: SHA-256 hex of `modelID + "\u{0}" + sessionID` + `.safetensors`. The key strings can contain `/` (model ids do), thus they never go into a path directly.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] write → read gives an entry with equal `tokens`, `renderTokens`, equal cache `offset`s and `state` arrays, and equal `LMOutput.State`.
+- [ ] A read with the wrong key throws.
+- [ ] A truncated file, a file with another `format`, and a missing file each throw, and none crashes.
+- [ ] No `.partial` file remains after a successful write.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/ExecutorPromptCacheFileTests.swift` with the cases above, with `KVCacheSimple`, `RotatingKVCache` and `MambaCache` layers, and one entry with an `LMOutput.State`. Use a temporary directory.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXFoundationModelsTests.xctest` — all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+- `public func preparePromptCacheSave(cache:metadata:state:) throws -> PromptCacheSaveInput` — reads `state`/`metaState` of each cache synchronously. The caller runs it while it owns the caches.
